# t-test against true {#sec-ttest_true}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    t = \frac{\bar{x} - \mu_0}{ s/ \sqrt{n}}
$${#eq-t-test}

$$
    t = \frac{\bar{x} - \mu_0}{ \hat{\sigma}/ \sqrt{n}}
$${#eq-t-test-unknown-variance}

$$
    t = \frac{\bar{x_1} - \bar{x_2}}{ \sqrt{s_1^2/n_1 + s_2^2/n_2 }}
$${#eq-t-test-unequal}

$$
    df = \frac{\left(\frac{s_1^2}{n_1} + \frac{s_2^2}{n_2}\right)^2}{\frac{(s_1^2/n_1)^2}{n_1-1} + \frac{(s_2^2/n_2)^2}{n_2-1}}
$${#eq-welch-df}


## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "One-Sample t-test: Known Mean and Unknown Variance"
#| label: fig-ttest-case1

# Case 1: One-sample t-test against a known mean (variance unknown)
# Testing if sample mean differs from a hypothesized population mean
set.seed(123)
sample_data <- rnorm(30, mean = 5.5, sd = 2)
mu_0 <- 5  # hypothesized population mean

# Run one-sample t-test
result_case1 <- t.test(sample_data, mu = mu_0)
print("Case 1: One-sample t-test (H0: μ = 5)")
print(result_case1)

# Interpretation:
# If p-value > 0.05: we fail to reject H0 (sample mean could equal the hypothesized mean)
# If p-value < 0.05: we reject H0 (sample mean significantly differs from the hypothesized mean)
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "One-Sample t-test: Comparing Two Means"
#| label: fig-ttest-case2

# Case 2: Paired samples or comparing two means with unequal variances
# Two independent samples
set.seed(456)
group1 <- rnorm(25, mean = 10, sd = 2)
group2 <- rnorm(25, mean = 11, sd = 3)

# Run two-sample t-test with equal variances assumed
result_case2a <- t.test(group1, group2, var.equal = TRUE)
print("Case 2a: Two-sample t-test (Equal variances)")
print(result_case2a)

# Run two-sample t-test with unequal variances (Welch's t-test)
result_case2b <- t.test(group1, group2, var.equal = FALSE)
print("\nCase 2b: Welch's t-test (Unequal variances)")
print(result_case2b)

# Interpretation:
# If p-value > 0.05: we fail to reject H0 (group means are not significantly different)
# If p-value < 0.05: we reject H0 (group means are significantly different)
```

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Visualization of t-test Comparisons"
#| label: fig-ttest-plots

# Set up 1x2 panel layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Panel 1: Boxplot for Case 1 (sample vs. hypothesized mean)
boxplot(sample_data, main = "Case 1: Sample Data vs μ₀=5",
        ylab = "Values", col = "lightblue", border = "black", lwd = 1.5)
abline(h = mu_0, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = "μ₀ = 5", col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2, cex = 0.8)

# Panel 2: Boxplot comparing two groups
boxplot(list(Group1 = group1, Group2 = group2),
        main = "Case 2: Comparing Two Groups",
        ylab = "Values", col = c("lightblue", "lightcoral"), border = "black", lwd = 1.5)

# Reset plot layout
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
